card.name: Partway through dosing-section drug terms
card.fires_on: Partway through a drug name or dosing term in prescribing text, such as the 'on' of add-on, 'itin' in tofacitinib or 'uv' in rosuvastatin. It also fires on 'initial' in 'used as initial therapy'.

modes.label: Add-on / initial therapy
modes.description: The word piece after 'add-' or the word 'initial' when describing how a drug is used in therapy.
modes.example: May be used as add<<-on>> therapy for patients not controlled on monotherapy

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a long generic or brand drug name in dosing instructions.
modes.example: In patients tolerating 5 mg dapaglif<<lo>>zin and 5 mg saxaglipt

card.plain: It lights up inside long drug names and phrases like add-on therapy in dosing instructions.
